summary: Improve donor pipelines, proposal logic and grant stewardship with practical public sector tools. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Donor engagement training helps public sector leaders, programme managers and partnership specialists connect funding opportunities with public priorities. They practise prioritising donor pipelines, assessing funding fit through a Theory of Change, and preparing proposal logic, due-diligence records and stewardship updates tied to indicators and reporting evidence.
audienceIntro: This course suits public sector professionals who develop funding relationships, prepare proposals or oversee donor-funded programmes and need to link external support to public outcomes.
modules: OECD DAC Criteria and Public Value
Theory of Change and Funding Fit
prerequisites: Working familiarity with public sector programme delivery, donor-funded projects or grant reporting is expected. No coding or programming is required.
